chainShort.text: parcels approved → sowing / season notes (mostly mobile) → harvest plan near pick.
batch → pack to PACKED / QUALITY_VERIFIED → quality entry → compliance photos + label roll.
request transport → dispatcher assigns driver → pickup & handover → cold chain → hub or buyer · missions track the run · buyer allocations are done in ops, not auto in the app.

intro.sidebarBlurb: Go 1→12 in order. The left menu is the same journey; here each card is one beat you can scan quickly.

myFieldsCta.title: My fields
myFieldsCta.line: Draw blocks and crops when you start.

steps.title: Dashboard
paragraphs: Alerts, active lots, messages, suggested next step — glance every few visits.

steps.title: This checklist
paragraphs: Twelve cards on one page · same order as the sidebar (app: bottom tabs mirror the flow).

steps.title: My fields (parcels)
paragraphs: Estate + parcels · m² · crop · batches / diary / treatments on a block stay limited until admin approves the parcel.

steps.title: Approval
paragraphs: Wait for approved · locked screens are normal · ping ops via messages if stalled.

steps.title: Materials & suppliers
paragraphs: Catalog (crates, rolls, foil, serials) · directory + B2B orders · mark received · app: Materials + Partner orders / web: Suppliers & orders.

steps.title: Field work
paragraphs: Daily: mobile entry log, journals, compliant sprays/treatments (GPS when required). Before harvest submit a kg/window harvest plan — for planning, not a retail checkout. Borders on web, captures in the field.

steps.title: Harvest → batch
paragraphs: When ready: declare harvest · create batch linked to parcel · use mobile flows for qty / window.

steps.title: Packing & status
paragraphs: Work the lot until PACKED or QUALITY_VERIFIED · transport waits until packing + compliance (next step).

steps.title: Quality & compliance pics
paragraphs: (1) Quality entry · (2) Compliance photos + label roll · transport form validates both.

steps.title: Request transport
paragraphs: Only after packed / verified + compliance · pickup GPS/address + destination · queued until dispatcher assigns driver.
steps.footnote: Who ships which kg to which buyer is set in ops — not inferred from forecasts in-app.

steps.title: Missions
paragraphs: Handover · cold chain · hub/buyer milestones · app: missions list · web: /grower/portal.

steps.title: Profile
paragraphs: Partner code, country, notifications · wallet & certs live under Profile on mobile.
